verdict: MCXN236 root cause verified and fixed; MCXN947 runtime not tested

cause.effect: Board clock-tree initialization does not restore consumer-enabled source outputs. FREQME configuration and routing restore successfully but no source clock reaches the measurement block.
cause.fix: Save CLOCK_CTRL in retained static storage before S2RAM and restore it after board_early_init_hook, before device resume.
cause.uart_domain_hypothesis: Not the cause of the reproduced MCXN236 measurement failure: UART driver, LP_FLEXCOMM wrapper and MCXN domain wiring were unchanged in all arms. This does not validate all UART PM behavior.

experiment.method: Native UART-only A/B/A; no GDB stream during any run. Same checkout, same Kconfig, same app and same MCXN UART/domain wiring. Negative control removes only CLOCK_CTRL preservation.

runs.arm: same-source negative control without clock restore
identical candidate reflashed after negative control

post_resume_ctrlstat.difference: RESULT_READY_STAT 0x04000000 appears with restored source output

known_build_warnings: ELF LOAD segment with RWX permissions

limitations: MCXN947 not run on hardware; the shared fix does not constitute its runtime verification.
No new full-matrix job, commit or push.
Exact failing API return code was not captured; do not assert a measured ETIMEDOUT value.
Earlier direct-GDB gate-toggle attempts failed at the transport layer and are not causality evidence.
